_doc: DayZero app catalog. The wizard's review screen shows every app here, grouped by category;
the apps a mode lists in modes.json are ticked, everything else can be ticked by hand.
Custom mode starts with nothing ticked (or with what you picked in the builder).
categories: display order and titles. pickOne = radio buttons (choose one, or None).
winget:     the exact winget package id. Each id was checked against Microsoft's winget-pkgs
repository (tests/data/winget-ids-verified.txt). At install time DayZero runs
'winget show --id <id> --exact' first; if the id is gone it runs 'winget search' and
logs what it found instead of guessing. tools\Test-DzAppIds.ps1 re-checks every id.
msstore:    Microsoft Store id, for apps that are only published there (WhatsApp).
kind:       'office' = Microsoft 365 Apps through the Office Deployment Tool (see office.json).
elevated:   false = install as the signed-in user without admin rights. Needed for installers that
refuse admin (Spotify) and for per-user apps, so they don't start as administrator.
scope:      optional 'machine' or 'user', passed to winget --scope.
